title: WCSB Egress: The Takeaway Stack, Rail and the Diluent Import Legs
dek: Egress stands at 5,096 kb/d (5,011 kb/d of crude pipes plus 85 kb/d of economic rail) against 5,031 kb/d of marketable supply in October 2026, a +66 kb/d spare that the Trans Mountain and Mainline expansions widen through 2027 and 2028. The Mainline carries about three fifths of the pipe stack on an all-spot basis; the committed pipes (Trans Mountain, Keystone) are the contracted core; and the two inbound condensate legs are drawn because diluent supply and egress economics are one picture.
